'''Kav Goldor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Some time after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|defend]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] from an attack by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kav Goldor was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kav Goldor was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Tusken Army|"Tusken Army" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:TR" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
